scope_statement: Gate 0A decides ONE proposition: on the shared genotype panel, is there any cheap nonlinear low-dimensional map that preserves more genetic/phenotype signal than the matched linear reconstruction null, per DGP regime. It does NOT test the pretrained encoder (Gate 0B) and does NOT test Grassmann geometry (Gate 1).
primary_linear_null_rationale: PCA is the linear RECONSTRUCTION optimum (not an upper bound over all linear phenotype-retention methods). Under the unsupervised reconstruction objective it is the matched linear comparator. The primary null uses the same MAF-standardized input the kernel encoder sees so preprocessing cannot confound the comparison.
seed_namespace_note: disjoint from rc1 (904e6+0), from v6.1 (629e6), and from any v7 GPU/A1-R seed block

input_preprocessing.stats_estimated_from: outer-training-fold ONLY (p, mean, sd); no leakage

representation_budget.total_budget_definition: D_total(k) = sum_b min(k, m_b) over blocks b with m_b SNPs
representation_budget.decision_axis: total_representation_budget (NOT per-block k); per-block k is reported alongside

B_rand_bilinear.name: random_bilinear_quadratic_features_dim_k
B_rand_bilinear.note: at Gate 0A this is a descriptive 'cheaper generic nonlinear map?' reference; it becomes the MATCHED comparator only at Gate 1, where the test arm is an actual Grassmann feature

downstream.note: CV folds are used for penalty selection and fitting, NOT as the inferential unit

metrics.primary_decision_metric: R2_genetic(k) = R2(g, g_hat), g_hat = downstream(Z_k) fit to the KNOWN genetic value g
metrics.primary_rationale: separates representation loss from phenotype noise; independent of the p>>n full-genotype ceiling problem
metrics.dropped_from_round_1: AUC / binary traits (no penetrance/liability/prevalence/scale defined; add only after Gate 0A)

inference.not_used: CV-fold CIs (folds are not independent replicates)

primary_summary_across_k.rationale: avoids selection bias from picking argmax_k after seeing results

kill_criterion.gate_0A_headroom_kill_per_regime: within EACH pre-registered DGP regime SEPARATELY, at the primary budget points, if A_test_primary's paired-mean Delta R2_genetic vs B_pca_z has a replicate-bootstrap 95% CI that does NOT exclude zero, then unsupervised nonlinear compression has no headroom in that regime
kill_criterion.no_pooling_rule: The paired-mean criterion is evaluated separately within each pre-registered DGP regime; no pooled cross-regime average is used for the primary decision.
kill_criterion.program_implication: if A_test fails even the spectral_tail and between_block_interaction regimes, the unsupervised spectral-compression premise is wrong and the unsupervised path to Stage 1/2 stops; regimes where it passes define the headroom carried forward to Gate 0B
kill_criterion.removed_from_rc1: the Grassmann geometry-specificity kill is DELETED: Gate 0A has no Grassmann arm and cannot decide Grassmann-specificity
kill_criterion.margin: Delta R2_genetic margin frozen by the DETECTABILITY_GATE before any run

cost_ledger.secondary_decision_axis: equal retention at lower budget/cost is a win; a tiny retention gain at large cost is not; restores the two-dimensional (retention x cost) judgement
